(323)gnyis pa zor lam bsal ba ni/hūm̐/bdag ni ma nyes ma yo'o/gzu dang dpung du dkon mchog bzhugs/steng gi lha yang sku gzur cigasteng na gnas pa'i lha

tei:div.tei:p: gnyis pa zor lam bsal ba ni/ hūm̐/ bdag ni ma nyes ma yo'o/ gzu dang dpung du dkon mchog bzhugs/ steng gi lha yang sku gzur cig steng na gnas pa'i lha rnams kun/ mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ do nub zor lam gnyan po phyes/ 'og gi klu yang sku gzur cig 'og na nags pa'i klu rnams kun/ mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ do nub zer lam (324)gnyan po phyes/ ban gyi srung ma sku gzur cig ban gyi srung ma thams cad kyang*/ mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ do nub zor lam gnyan po phyes/ bon gyi lha gsas sku gzur cig bon gyi lha gsas thams cad kyang*/ mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ do nub zor lam gnyan po phyes/ 'og ba'i lha lnga sku gzur cig 'og ba'i lha lnga thams cad kyang*/ mchod sbyin gser (325)(326)skyems 'di bzhes la/ do nub zor lam gnyan po phyes/ yul gyi lha yang sku gzur cig yul lha gnyan po thams cad kyang*/ mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ do nub zor lam gnyan po phyes/ snang srid lha 'dre sku gzur cig snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyang*/ mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ do nub zor lam gnyan po phyes/// /
